Explain workflow, buyer inputs, voice and casting choices, editing, quality acceptance, deliverables, rights and quote variables.
Link to the existing official audiobook service route using its exact verified URL.
Do not invent a fixed price, deadline, rights grant, client result or production capacity.
Keep Audio+ separate from corporate and individual-entrepreneur orders.

items.hypothesis: An authorized and attested agent-operated RU environment can execute the frozen first-wave baseline once; reruns are needed only after meaningful changes or a defined comparison interval.
success_criteria: Use the frozen RU prompt sets without silently editing them.
Capture full answers, surface, time, exact prompt, account state, grounding mode and source evidence.
Pass the complete region and operator attestation before labelling any observation RU.
Store blocked or unavailable states explicitly and never score them as zero visibility.
Run existing evidence validators and produce a decision-oriented summary.

items.decision_to_unlock: How AI systems should distinguish the individual short-order product from professional project services and describe uncertain eligibility, deliverables, revisions and rights without making unsupported current promises.
items.hypothesis: A connected entity/route/offer ontology that preserves source disagreements will improve semantic disambiguation and reduce incorrect B2B routing; it does not guarantee citations, ranking or sales.

Encode one-order/one-file, buyer eligibility, video-category mismatch, revision disagreement and rights boundary without presenting old values as current terms.
Keep prices, deadlines and edit options out of current Offer claims unless live-verified.
Link the product entity and ontology from the repository MAP and llms index.
Pass the naming gate, route registry validation, AI Discoverability contract tests and repository integrity workflow.

items.title: Evaluate an Alice skill order channel for Audio+
items.obstacle: The owner proposed a non-generative Alice skill that collects a short Audio+ order in dialogue and passes it to the existing backend. External publication to the Alice catalog, Yandex Dialogs or IndexNow distribution is outside the authorized contour: the 25-Nov-2026 owner order permits autonomous publication only in GitHub/GitLab repositories and forbids non-repository external surfaces. Brand rights, the execution path and order-backend access are unconfirmed.
items.decision_to_unlock: Whether Audio+ may publish a useful dialog skill in the Alice catalog and deliver a confirmed order to the existing backend while payment stays on the existing checkout page.
items.hypothesis: A non-generative dialog skill can collect an order inside the catalog without paid LLM tokens. This is an owner-supplied hypothesis, not a verified platform or commercial result; any order or revenue effect still requires attribution.
success_criteria: Record an explicit owner decision naming the permitted external surface and the brand-rights basis before any external action.
Specify the dialog utility that helps the user inside the conversation instead of redirecting traffic to the website.
Define the safe adapter boundary toward the existing order backend; change no backend without authorized access.
Keep payment on the existing checkout page and do not invent an in-dialog payment flow.
Keep the Alice skill catalog surface separate from Alice AI SoV and from search markup.
items.blocker: No owner authorization for the Alice skill catalog, Yandex Dialogs or IndexNow external surface; no confirmed brand rights; no authorized access to the order backend.
items.unblock_condition: The owner issues a specific written authorization naming the external surface, brand-rights basis and execution path, and supplies an authorized adapter or backend contact; PUBLISHING_AUTHORITY and AGENT_CONTRACT are updated accordingly.

items.title: Connect PR-CY MCP as a permanent read-only analytics source
items.obstacle: PR-CY was available as a tariffed external analytics account but was not a persistent read-only MCP source in the active OpenCode configuration, so its project metadata and report views could not be used with a fixed provenance record.
items.decision_to_unlock: Whether existing PR-CY project metadata and connected GSC/Metrica report views add a usable read-only signal without writes, paid checks or new AI requests.
items.hypothesis: A persistent read-only MCP connection can add dated secondary analytics evidence, but empty views and traffic sessions must not be interpreted as AI visibility, leads or zero demand.
success_criteria: Keep the remote MCP server in user-scope config with env-based authorization and no literal key.
Verify the server remains connected after a background-service restart.
Call only read tools; do not run position/prompt checks, mutations, exports or paid reports.
Record retrieval date, reporting period, source, engine, region and device for every dataset.
Record project, limits, keyword state, GSC views and Metrica views with explicit empty/not-verified states.
Keep AI/lead effects unknown and official-site state unchanged.

measurement_guard.decision_to_unlock: Prioritize follow-up repository or owner-ready tasks from dated search and session evidence without conflating it with AI answer share.
measurement_guard.minimum_sufficient_sample: One initial snapshot of limits, project metadata, keyword state, connected GSC views and default Metrica report views.
measurement_guard.stop_rule: Stop before any paid, mutating or external-publication operation; record tariff or permission blockers instead of guessing.
